Counsel for Applicant :- Ramkripal Yadav Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Saurabh Lavania,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the material on record.

The instant application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. read with Section 528 Bharatiya Nagrik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (in short "BNSS") has been filed by the applicant to permit him to submit two sureties and personal bond in all seven cases in which he was roped only one arrest and applicant has been granted bail in all cases by the court concerned.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is innocent and he has falsely been implicated in seven cases.
He next submitted that in all the cases registered against the applicant, he has been granted bail by the court concerned.
He says that the applicant is not in a position to furnish huge sureties in each and every case in compliance of bail orders.

It is further submitted that the details of cases registered against applicant at District Lucknow are as follows:-
(i) Case Crime No. 0009/ 2020, Under Sections- 420,120B I.P.C and 66C IT Act,
P.S.- Cyber crime, District- Lucknow.
(ii) Case Crime No. 0013/ 2020, Under Sections- 419,420,120B I.P.C, and 66C & 66D IT Act, P.S.- Cyber Crime, District- Lucknow.
(iii) Case Crime No. 0015/ 2020, Under Sections- 419,420,120? ?.P.C and 66C &
66D, IT Act, P.S. Cyber Crime, District- Lucknow.
(iv) Case Crime No. 0005/ 2021, Under Sections- 419,420,120B I.P.C. and 66C &
66D IT Act, P.S. Cyber Crime, District-Lucknow.
(v) Case Crime No. 0007/ 2021, Under Sections- 419,420,120B I.P.C. and 66C IT Act,
P.S.- Cyber Crime, District- Lucknow.
(vi) Case crime No. 0012/2021, Under Sections- 419,420,120B IPC and 66C & 66D IT Act, P.S-Cyber crime, District - Lucknow.
(vii) Case crime No. 0029/2021, Under Sections- 419,420,120B IPC and 66D IT Act,
P.S Cyber Crime, District- Lucknow.

Learned counsel for the applicant has relied upon the judgment of the Apex Court passed in Special Leave to Appeal (Criminal) No. 8914-8915 of 2018; Hani Nishad @ Mohammad Imran @ Vikky Vs.
State of U.P. Learned A.G.A. submits that he does not want to file any counter affidavit.

entities.text: Special Leave to Appeal (Criminal) No. 8914-8915 of 2018
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

entities.text:
Hani Nishad @ Mohammad Imran @ Vikky Vs.
State of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In view of the facts and circumstances as well as rival submissions advanced by the learned counsel for both the parties, the present application stands disposed of finally in the light law laid down by the Apex Court in the case of Hani Nishad @ Mohammad Imran @ Vikky (Supra) and the Court below is directed to execute the personal bond of Rs. 20,000/- in every case and produce two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the Court/Magistrate concerned in one case which shall hold good for rest of the cases.

Order Date :- 15.7.2024 Arun/-
